protocol.inner_cv: 3 target-stratified folds within each outer training partition
protocol.calibration: No posthoc calibration fit; report Brier and five equal-width reliability bins
protocol.auc_ci: 1000 patient bootstrap resamples of fixed development OOF predictions; conditional, excludes retraining uncertainty
protocol.comparison: Logistic remains the explainable prototype irrespective of score; small tree is a benchmark, no winner selection on OOF
limitations: Small single-dataset feasibility study; no external or prospective validation.
No clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
Displayed local contributions are exact linear-model decomposition, not causal effects.
